name: How do I choose the right contractor for my luxury home extension?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my luxury home extension?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for a luxury home extension involves looking for experience specifically with high-end projects and a strong portfolio of similar work. Verify licenses, insurance, and read client testimonials or request references. Communication style, transparency in budgeting, and a clear understanding of your vision are also crucial. A reputable builder will provide detailed proposals, outline the process, and demonstrate a commitment to quality craftsmanship, design integration, and customer satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a contractor with experience in luxury extensions, a strong portfolio, verified licenses, insurance, and excellent client references. Good communication and budget transparency are key.
